description: This source file contains unit tests for the NetworkManager plugin, testing various functionalities such as interface state management, IP setting configurations, and logging levels, primarily utilizing Google Test framework and mocking dependencies of libnm and other related components.

classes.name: NetworkManagerTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for setting up Google Test environment for NetworkManager plugin, including mocking dependencies, initializing plugin instances, and cleanup.

methods.name: RegisteredMethods
methods.description: Test that checks the existence of various registered plugin methods.

methods.name: SetLogLevel
methods.description: Test that verifies setting the log level via the plugin API triggers the correct command execution.

methods.name: SetHostName_null
methods.description: Test that setting hostname with an empty string results in failure response.

methods.name: SetHostName_ClientCon_Null
methods.description: Test hostname setting when client connection list is null.

methods.description: Test hostname setting when connection interface is 'unknown'.

methods.name: SetHostName_iface_wlan0

methods.name: GetPrimaryInterface_empty
methods.description: Test retrieval of primary interface when no interfaces are enabled.

methods.name: GetInterfaceState_Failed

methods.description: Test getting interface state for Ethernet and WiFi devices, verifying enabled status based on device state.

methods.name: GetInterfaceState_WifiEthNotFound
methods.description: Test getting interface state when interface is not found among devices.

methods.name: GetInterfaceState_unknown
methods.description: Test getting interface state for an unknown interface, expecting general failure.

methods.name: GetAvailableInterfaces_DevicesNull
methods.description: Test fetching available interfaces when device list is null.

methods.name: GetAvailableInterfaces_Enabled
methods.description: Test fetching enabled interfaces with multiple devices, verifying the list and details.

methods.name: GetAvailableInterfaces_disabled
methods.description: Test fetching interfaces when all devices are disabled (unmanaged).

methods.name: GetIPSettings_unknown_iface
methods.description: Test fetching IP settings for an unknown interface, expecting failure.

methods.name: GetIPSettings_invalidDevice
methods.description: Test fetching IP settings when device is null.

methods.name: GetIPSettings_invalid_state
methods.description: Test fetching IP settings for a device with an invalid state (unmanaged).

methods.name: GetIPSettings_interface_Empty
methods.description: Test fetching IP settings with empty interface string.

methods.name: GetIPSettings_GetPrimary_failed
methods.description: Test GetIPSettings function when internal GetPrimary() call fails.

methods.name: GetIPSettings_Invalid_ActiveConnection
methods.description: Test fetching IP settings when active connections list is null.

methods.name: GetIPSettings_Invalid_Connection
methods.description: Test fetching IP settings when active connection does not contain a valid connection object.

methods.name: GetIPSettings_interface_Empty
methods.description: Duplicate test for empty interface string handling in GetIPSettings.

methods.name: GetIPSettings_ipv4_config
methods.description: Test fetching IPv4 address and details from a valid active connection.

methods.name: GetIPSettings_ipv4_configAutoConftrue
methods.description: Test IPv4 configuration fetch when DHCP method is 'auto'.

methods.name: GetIPSettings_ipv4_configAutoConfNull
methods.description: Test IPv4 configuration when DHCP method is not 'auto'.

methods.name: GetIPSettings_ipv4_config_valid
methods.description: Test complete IPv4 IP settings retrieval, including DNS, gateway, and DHCP server.

methods.name: GetIPSettings_ipv6_config_valid
methods.description: Test complete IPv6 IP settings retrieval, including DNS, gateway, and prefix length.

methods.name: SetInterfaceState_deviceFailed_wlan0
methods.description: Test setting interface state when device retrieval fails for wlan0.

methods.name: SetInterfaceState_wlan0_already_diconnected
methods.description: Test disabling WLAN interface 'wlan0' when already disconnected.

methods.description: Test disconnecting 'wlan0' if it is activated.

methods.name: SetInterfaceState_wlan0_deactivated_ErroCode
methods.description: Test failure in disconnecting interface 'wlan0' with error code.

methods.name: SetInterfaceState_wlan0_enable_success
methods.description: Test enabling 'wlan0' interface when it is unmanaged.

methods.name: SetInterfaceState_eth0_enable_success
methods.description: Test enabling Ethernet 'eth0' interface when it is unmanaged.

methods.name: SetIPSettings_interface_empty
methods.description: Test setting static IP with empty interface string, expecting failure.

methods.description: Test setting IP when device lookup returns null.

methods.description: Test setting IP when connection list is null.

methods.description: Test setting IP with existing connection object.
